# Hotkeys: an icon, the key and a word for each (Ventoy's own line of them is @VTOY_HOTKEY_TIP@).
# The icons are key_*.png, made by build-theme.py. Each slot is as wide as its text, in pixels,
# so the row fits a 1024-pixel screen and stays over the dark side of the artwork on a wide one.
